metadata.question: Since 2001, has the forest in Tshopo province around Kisangani lost less than 15,000 square kilometers of tree cover?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset for tree cover loss - Focus on Tshopo province, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), around Kisangani - Time period: 2001 onwards (Hansen dataset covers 2000-2023) - Need to sum total tree cover loss area 2. Masking strategy: - Use the 'lossyear' band to filter loss from 2001 onwards (values 1-23 represent 2001-2023) - Mask to only include pixels with loss > 0 - Need to define Tshopo province geometry (approximate bounds around Kisangani) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: Total loss area calculated successfully - A: Loss < 15,000 km² - B: Loss ≥ 15,000 km² - C3: If result is None/NaN or calculation fails - C2: If no valid pixels after masking (unlikely for this large region) - C1: Dataset should always be available ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Tshopo Province geometry (approximate bounds around Kisangani) // Kisangani is approximately at 0.52°N, 25.19°E // Tshopo province covers a large area in northeastern DRC const tshopo = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[23.0, -1.0], [27.0, -1.0], [27.0, 2.0], [23.0, 2.0], [23.0, -1.0]] ]); // 2. Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // 3. Extract loss year band (values 1-23 represent years 2001-2023) const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // 4. Create mask for loss since 2001 (lossyear > 0) const lossSince2001 = lossYear.gt(0); // 5. Calculate pixel count to check for valid data const pixelCount = lossSince2001.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: tshopo, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count = await pixelCount.get('lossyear').getInfo(); if (count === null || count === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - no valid result"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (count === 0) { console.log("No tree cover loss detected (0 pixels)"); console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Calculate area of loss in square kilometers // Each pixel is ~30m x 30m = 900 m² = 0.0009 km² const pixelAreaKm2 = 0.0009; const lossAreaKm2 = count * pixelAreaKm2; // 7. Validate result if (lossAreaKm2 < 0 || isNaN(lossAreaKm2)) { console.log("Invalid calculation result"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 8. Print evidence and answer console.log(`Tree cover loss pixels: ${Math.round(count)}`); console.log(`Total tree cover loss area: ${lossAreaKm2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Threshold: 15,000 km²`); if (lossAreaKm2 < 15000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
